title: Maintenance Manual for the Orvale Grain Dryer

headings.text: Maintenance Manual for the Orvale Grain Dryer

key_sentences: This manual covers the model D4 dryer installed in farm cooperatives since 2021.
Read every section before opening the service panel.
The dryer runs on a three-phase supply and contains a gas burner.
Turn the red switch on the left side of the cabinet to the off position.
Lock it with your personal padlock before touching any wiring.
Measure the resistance between the frame and the earth bar once a month.
Keep hands clear of the auger while the drum is turning.
Empty the dust tray at the end of each shift.
Wipe the moisture sensor with a dry cloth.
